content.rendered:
As an Intake Specialist at Franco Muñoz, Yahaira plays a pivotal role in ensuring a smooth and efficient process for clients seeking compensation and support for workplace-related injuries. With her keen attention to detail and compassionate demeanor, Yahaira serves as the initial point of contact for individuals navigating the complexities of workers' compensation claims.

Yahaira attended Humboldt State University, where she discovered a profound love for the outdoors and the stunning scenery that surrounded the campus.

In her free time, Yahaira enjoys being a makeup maven and Disney devotee. When she isn't excelling as an intake coordinator, you'll find her wielding brushes, lost in the magic of Disney, or spending time with her beloved dog Gypsy. She believes in maintaining a healthy work-life balance to ensure she can continue to deliver the highest standard of care and support to Franco Muñoz’s clients.
